title: gw-service admin interface reachable via public listener
severity_justification: Evidence artifacts a1..a3 show an unauthenticated admin route reachable from the public listener (reproduced twice), giving full configuration control to any network peer in the authorized segment.
claim: The admin interface bound to 127.0.0.1:9090 is proxied by the public listener without authentication.
reproduction: 1. From an authorized lab host, request https://gw-service@203.0.113.10:8443/admin/
2. Observe the admin console HTML returned without any authentication prompt
3. POST to /admin/config with the documented test payload; observe config change echoed
root_cause: The reverse proxy passes /admin/* to the loopback admin service without applying the auth middleware used for other routes.
mitigation: Apply the auth middleware to the /admin location block; regression test asserts 403 for unauthenticated /admin requests.
lessons_learned: Proxy route tables are part of the trust-boundary model; inventory should capture route-to-upstream mappings.

provenance.notes: fixture demonstrating a fully-evidenced confirmed finding
